Privacy policy

Last updated: 2026-11-01

In plain words: We collect your name and mobile number so you can use the stamp card. Your shop owner sees your visits. We do not sell your data and we do not use advertising cookies. You can ask us to delete your data at any time.

Who we are

Stamp is operated by [[FILL: legal entity name, e.g. "Stamp Technologies LLP"]], registered at [[FILL: full registered address]].

Grievance officer: [[FILL: grievance officer name]], [[FILL: grievance officer email]].

Data we collect

Customers

  • Name and mobile number (to sign in and identify you at the shop).
  • Stamp, scratch card and reward activity with timestamps.
  • Browser notification subscription, if you allow it.
  • One-time code records, stored as a one-way hash.
  • IP address, used only for security and rate-limiting.

Location

If you allow it, your position is compared with the shop's location to flag stamps that look far away. We do not store your coordinates.

Shop owners

  • Owner mobile number, shop name, shop location, program settings and activity.

Website visitors

  • Contact form details (name, phone, email, message).
  • Standard server logs (IP address, browser type, pages visited, timestamps).

We do not use advertising cookies. Analytics is off.

Why we use each item

  • Sign in: your mobile number confirms your identity via a one-time code.
  • Stamps and rewards: we record visits so you and the shop can track progress.
  • Reminders: browser notifications tell you when a reward is ready or when you have not visited in a while.
  • Fraud prevention: IP address, location comparison, and one-time codes stop misuse.
  • Support: contact form details let us reply to you.

Who sees it

  • The shop owner sees their own customers' activity (name, phone, stamps, rewards). They do not see other shops' customers.
  • Service providers we use: [[FILL: names of SMS provider, hosting provider, browser push service]].
  • We do not sell your data. [[FILL: owner to confirm "we do not sell data"]]

How long we keep it

  • Customer account data: [[FILL: retention period, e.g. "as long as your account is active, plus 12 months after you delete it"]].
  • Stamp and reward records: [[FILL: retention period]].
  • Contact form submissions: 12 months, then automatically deleted.
  • Server logs: [[FILL: retention period, e.g. "90 days"]].

Your rights

Under India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, you have the right to:

  • Access your data — see what we hold about you.
  • Correct inaccurate information.
  • Erase your data — ask us to delete it.
  • Withdraw consent — stopping is as easy as giving consent was.
  • Nominate someone to act on your behalf.
  • Complain if you are not satisfied with how we handle your data.

To use any of these rights, submit a data request or contact our grievance officer at [[FILL: grievance officer email]].

We will respond within [[FILL: response time, e.g. "30 days". The law allows up to 90 days.]].

If you are not satisfied, you may complain to the Data Protection Board of India.

Security

We use HTTPS for all traffic, hash sensitive tokens, restrict database access, and keep software up to date. No system is perfectly secure, but we take reasonable steps to protect your data.

If we discover a data breach that affects you, we will notify you and the Data Protection Board of India as required by law.

Children

This service is for people aged 18 and over. [[FILL: owner to confirm the age rule. Under-18 users need verifiable parental consent under the DPDP Act.]]

Cookies

The product app uses a session cookie to keep you signed in. It is essential for the service to work and is not used for tracking.

This marketing website does not set any cookies.

Changes to this policy

We may update this policy from time to time. When we do, we will update the date at the top and, if the change is significant, notify you through the app or by email.
